tokens.name: surface

tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings; the PHOENIX part of the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, the tagline under the wordmark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Brand colour: the phoenix and the rising strand of the loop. Large shapes and accents, not small text.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: Back wing of the mark, deep accents, hover on copper-strong.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Flame highlight: the front feather, the crest, and the 8 in the wordmark on dark. On dark it is also text-safe (8:1).

tokens.name: text-on-copper

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The steel half of the infinity loop; icons, control borders, chart baselines.

tokens.name: copper-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for callouts, tags and selected states.
